proposals.title: Invalidate feature cache v38 — rebuild with Cat47-50
proposals.rationale: Current Kaggle cache is features_cache_v38.npz, built before Cat47 (Drive-Rim Matchup), Cat48 (Passing), Cat49 (Play-Type PPP), Cat50 (Market Microstructure) were added to engine.py. Forcing a cache rebuild gives Karpathy access to 6253 features instead of ~5800. The GA on HF islands already benefits from these categories (S12/S13 at 0.220xx).

proposals.title: Add CatBoost and LightGBM as primary mutation targets
proposals.rationale: S13 CatBoost is fleet best at 0.22066. Karpathy has tried extra_trees 27/30 iters, random_forest 1/30, gradient_boosting 1/30. CatBoost is never tried. Per fleet data, CatBoost extracts different feature interactions than ExtraTrees — especially with categorical-like integer features (game codes, team IDs). LightGBM DART (nba-lightgbm-dart-odds proposal) also unexplored.

implementation.change: In nba_karpathy_loop.py mutation function, increase CatBoost/LightGBM sampling probability from current ~5% to 30% each. Add CatBoost-specific hyperparams to mutation: depth 6-10, l2_leaf_reg 1-10, border_count 32-128.

proposals.risk: LOW — fleet already validated CatBoost performance

proposals.title: Add Venn-Abers calibration post-processing step
proposals.rationale: arXiv:2502.05676 (ICML 2025) Venn-Abers calibration guarantees marginal calibration in finite samples. Current Brier on walk-forward 0.22447 vs Colab 0.21570 suggests calibration gap. Isotonic regression post-processing on a 10% holdout calibration set costs nothing and is proven to reduce ECE. Montrucchio 0.199 paper uses explicit calibration layer.

implementation.change: After model.predict_proba(), fit IsotonicRegression on 10% calibration holdout, apply to test predictions. Measure brier before and after.
implementation.code_snippet:
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
cal_idx = int(0.9 * len(X_train))
X_cal, y_cal = X_train[cal_idx:], y_train[cal_idx:]
X_train_fit = X_train[:cal_idx]
model.fit(X_train_fit, y_train[:cal_idx])
raw_cal = model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
ir = IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip').fit(raw_cal, y_cal)
test_probs = ir.transform(model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1])
brier = brier_score_loss(y_test, test_probs)

proposals.risk: LOW — isotonic calibration is reversible and standard

proposals.title: Expand feature swap radius to 20-30 features at iteration plateau
proposals.rationale: Karpathy is stuck: 12/13 recent iterations show no improvement with 5-10 feature swaps. This is a local minimum symptom. Standard autoresearch response: increase perturbation radius when stuck. Use adaptive perturbation: if last 5 iterations all failed, double the swap count (5→10→20). This is explicitly in Karpathy pattern — 'perturbation annealing'.

implementation.change: Track `no_improve_streak` counter. If streak >= 5: swap_size = min(30, current_size * 2). Reset on improvement.

proposals.risk: LOW — pure search strategy change, no data or model change

proposals.title: Seed Karpathy from S13 CatBoost champion config
proposals.rationale: S13 CatBoost fleet best is 0.22066 (gen 1002). Karpathy's best is 0.23179 — S13 is already 1.1 Brier points better. Karpathy is initialized from its own state (karpathy_state.json). If instead it seeds from the S13 feature_indices and CatBoost config, iteration 31 starts from a much stronger position. CLAUDE.md says: 'Seeds from live HF Space evolution islands' — this isn't happening currently.

implementation.change: Before Karpathy loop starts, fetch S13's best chromosome via HF Space API (/api/status → best_config). Use those feature_indices as initial state for Karpathy.
implementation.fallback: Use nba-best-config.json from git if API unavailable

proposals.risk: LOW — seeding is non-destructive, Karpathy can still mutate away
